name: frontend-engineering-agent-plugin
description: A prototype-driven frontend engineering knowledge agent with governed memory, mandatory interaction evidence, human approval gates, patch proposals, and review-driven memory updates.

interface.shortDescription: Operate frontend projects with governed engineering knowledge.
interface.longDescription: Require human-provided prototypes and click-result interactions for user-facing changes, build task-scoped context from project memory, analyze features, bugs, and refactors, design approved changes, apply human-reviewed patches, validate results, and convert code evolution into trusted engineering knowledge.
defaultPrompt: Validate the prototype and click-result interactions, then analyze this frontend change.
Design an implementation plan from this approved Change Contract.
Review this implementation and propose memory updates.
